correctness.rationale: For xi=(s,d,-s,d), g^n(xi) has trace coordinates (U_n,V_n)=(S_n,-S_n) at d=0 where S_n=s^(2^n); determinant coordinates equal d^(2^n). Thus F_n=phi(g^n(xi))=S_n²(2-S_n), and at S_n=2 its s derivative is -2^(n+3)/s_n0, nonzero, granting a unique local analytic branch by IFT. Differentiating the trace renormalization gives A_1=B_1=-2; A_(n+1)=-2S_n B_n, B_(n+1)=S_n(B_n-A_n). Normalization yields 2x2 constant recursion with eigenvalues 2 and -1, giving the parity coefficient s_n´(0)=-(1+(-1)^n 2^(1-n))/(3 s_n0). At n1 direct explicit radical differentiation yields Hdd=12, Hs=-8sqrt2 and H_d=0, so quadratic coefficient +3sqrt2/8. The fixed-depth component side assignment follows the earlier component theorem under strict nearby F_(n-1)>0 and F_(n+1)<0. Independently verified exact sympy Hdd,Hs,Hd and normalized derivatives through sample depths; finite root calculations not used as proof of all n.
residual_risks: Asymptotic neighborhoods depend on fixed n; no uniformity as n increases or crossing at d=0 claimed
Determinant positive d near zero and real square-root branch are necessary.
